isolatedDecision.finding: The builder's strongest sheet adds substantial layered protection and preserves the solved identity and grip, but the tasset-and-odachi language remains familiar and the wide studio guard lacks a decisive whole-body load, impact, acceleration, or recovery chain.

visualReview.benchmarkPolicy: Aggregate blinded-comparison results only; no benchmark image, crop, comparison sheet, filename, path, or other benchmark pixel is published.
visualReview.singleBiggestGap: A singular mechanics-driven storm-warden combat silhouette: the current samurai-adjacent tassets, odachi language, and wide studio guard must become one unmistakably ownable full-body force event in which blade mass visibly drives the spine, shoulders, pelvis, feet, and layered equipment.

decision.instruction: Preserve the improved costume hierarchy and solved contact, but do not begin paid 3D generation or Unity integration from this pack.

limitations: The filed image is original 2D concept art, not gameplay or game capture.
No actual game run was performed because this is a pre-Unity 2D concept gate.
No 3D mesh, topology, rig, deformation, UV, collision, animation, LOD, texture, performance, or game-ready claim is made.
The builder accepted the sheet for critic handoff; the independent critic rejected the isolated mythic-force target and complete composite gate.
The concept review cannot establish legal originality, exclusivity, copyright status, trademark clearance, or absence of all third-party similarity.
Paid 3D generation and Unity remain locked because the isolated target, total-score, category-floor, and blinded-comparison gates all failed.

conceptArt.label: CRITIC-REJECTED — builder-accepted mythic-force sheet
conceptArt.evidenceType: Rejected 2D concept evidence — not gameplay, 3D, or game-ready evidence
conceptArt.finding: The sheet materially improves costume layering and preserves one weapon plus two-hand contact, but remains a controlled samurai-adjacent studio guard rather than a singular force event.

builderAttempts.reason: Presentation-like base and insufficient pelvis, ribcage, shoulder, and equipment torque.
Hands remain too low to make the shoulders and upper back carry the blade.
Force improves, but the ring-like guard drifts from the accepted weapon language.
Strongest bounded output, but the fresh critic rejected its generic action language and insufficient full-body force.

nextRound.target: Create one ownable mechanics-driven signature action in which the split yoke, diagonal conductor, redesigned non-historical storm-harvesting blade, planted heavy right grounding greave, spine, shoulders, pelvis, feet, cloth, and plates all express the same deceleration force without samurai-adjacent tassets or a studio guard pose.
